objective.value: Can you review our year-end group accounts? We acquired 80% of a US business on 1 July, the subsidiary reports in USD, there are intercompany balances, goodwill looks high, and I want to know whether the consolidated accounts are right. I've attached the acquisition model, entity trial balances, intercompany schedules, FX rates, tax workpapers, impairment model and consolidation pack. Please test management's claim that the acquisition added the full-year subsidiary profit.
